name: @spellcontrol/deck-metrics
description: Isomorphic Commander deck metrics — the bracket estimator (hard floors, soft power score, signal breakdown) and its floor predicates. Shared by the SpellControl frontend (deck analysis, generation convergence) and backend (AI check_bracket tool). Zero runtime dependencies; pure functions only. Tag membership is INJECTED via TagLookup rather than imported, so the package carries no tagger data or I/O.

scripts.build: npm run clean && tsc -p tsconfig.cjs.json && tsc -p tsconfig.esm.json
